effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn. Then, if you have 2 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
